name: App Launcher
author: oparada1988
short_description: Launch any installed Linux desktop app, Flatpak, or Snap with automatic icon and label setup.
description:
Automatically discovers installed desktop applications across native packages, Flatpaks, and Snaps so you can launch them with a single tap from your Stream Deck.

Includes a searchable application picker, automatic Freedesktop icon and label setup, custom label overrides, and one-click app rescanning without restarting.

actions.name: Launch App
actions.description: Pick any system, Flatpak, or Snap app with automatic icon setup
